definitions.explanation: The return of money paid, such as when canceling a purchase, unused tickets, or overpayment.

examples.japanese: {切符|きっぷ}の{払戻|はらいもど}しを{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I received a refund for the ticket.

examples.japanese: {払戻|はらいもど}し{手数料|てすうりょう}がかかります。
examples.english: A refund processing fee will be charged.

examples.japanese: キャンセルした{場合|ばあい}、{払戻|はらいもど}しはできません。
examples.english: In case of cancellation, refunds are not available.

notes:
FORMATION:
{払|はら}い (paying) + {戻|もど}し (returning)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{払戻|はらいもど}しを{受|う}ける (to receive a refund)
・{払戻|はらいもど}しを{請求|せいきゅう}する (to request a refund)
・{払戻|はらいもど}し{手数料|てすうりょう} (refund fee)
・{払戻|はらいもど}し{期限|きげん} (refund deadline)

CONTEXT:
Commonly used for transportation tickets, event tickets, insurance policies, and financial products. The term is more formal than 「{返金|へんきん}」.
